name: CS Scholars
what_you_do: You spend four weeks living on the CMU campus. You learn computer science through classes and group projects. You hear faculty lectures and visit tech companies. All costs are covered.
who_can_apply: Students at least 16 by the program start, in 10th grade when applying, and U.S. citizens or permanent residents with a green card. Meant for students who lack access or resources in computer science.
pay_detail: Fully funded: tuition, housing and meals are free; limited travel help for families with transportation barriers
deadline_text: Application opens December 1, 2026. Deadline February 1, 2027 (decisions April 1, 2027).
how_to_apply: Apply online through the CMU Pre-College application portal from December 1, 2026 to February 1, 2027. Residential only; full participation required.
notes: The apply portal could not be read. Limited spots. Completers may be invited back to AI Scholars.
